items: Caption: Condition names, effects, and clearing guidance.
Gmgoal: Apply conditions as fictional pressure, not bookkeeping.

Gmnotes: Hidden: While out of sight from all foes and they do not know where you are, rolls against you have disadvantage. Clears when: An adversary moves where they would see you, you move into line of sight, or you make an attack. Restrained: You cannot move, but you can still take actions from your current position. Clears when: A temporary source is cleared with a fitting action roll, a stated feature requirement, or the source ends. Vulnerable: You are in a difficult position in the fiction; all rolls targeting you have advantage. Clears when: A temporary source is cleared with a fitting action roll, a stated feature requirement, or the source ends.
Playertakeaway: GM-only condition reference; explain only the condition currently affecting play.
Storytakeaway: Conditions express fictional pressure in the scene.
Mechanictakeaway: Apply and clear conditions using the official/local condition reference.
